description:
Priority: P0 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugin,P0 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none (registry OQ to be recorded in bitty-plugins-docs) | Task: CTX-0001

Bootstrap the new public repository bitty-terminal/bitty-plugins: official plugin directory, registry, store frontend, and official plugin aggregation repo.

Deliverables:
- baseline scaffold: AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY/CHANGELOG/TODO, justfile gates, lefthook, commitlint, markdownlint, CarryCtx baseline, issue/PR templates, dependabot (no npm updater)
- registry/schema.json (future kinds allowed), registry/official/activity.toml, registry/community/.gitkeep
- scripts: validate-registry.ts, generate-index.ts, sync-metadata.ts (bun + TypeScript only)
- generated/registry.json (schema_version, generated_at, plugins[] with official flag)
- app/: static vanilla-TS store (routes /, /plugins/<id>, /categories/<c>, /authors/<a>, /sdk, /create-plugin) reading only generated/registry.json
- submodules (HTTPS): sdk/ -> bitty-plugin-sdk, template/ -> bitty-plugin-template, plugins/activity/ -> activity
- CI: registry-check.yml (validate + regenerate + stale diff), plugin-integration.yml (full gates + submodule smoke), deploy.yml (workflow_dispatch, dormant until Cloudflare provisioning), codeql.yml
- gates: just check, actionlint, act -n, gitleaks, recurse-submodule clone verification

Authority: user-approved task; direct initial push to main is authorized. No force-pushes after initialization.
title: Bootstrap bitty-plugins repository

Cross-repo work for bitty CTX-0426 (registry: record official plugin onboarding order in bitty-plugins). Owner repo: bitty-plugins.

Deliverable: a short maintainer-facing registry section in README.md plus an AGENTS.md registry-contract rule that:
1. points to the canonical onboarding policy bitty-plugins-docs product/official-plugin-onboarding.md (canonical GitHub URL until the next docs submodule bump);
2. documents the mechanical maintainer steps: just registry-generate, just registry-validate, just registry-check, just check;
3. states that official plugin submodules must pin a commit reachable from the plugin repository mainline (default branch), never a feature-branch commit.

Out of scope: new validation gates. Policy-identified gaps are recorded separately: CTX-0005 (mainline pin check) and CTX-0006 (official entry to submodule mapping check).

Acceptance: README and AGENTS updated; just check and git diff --check green; no docs submodule bump required; PR linked to the docs policy PR and to bitty CTX-0426; no merge.

description:
Priority: P2 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugins,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-053 | Task: CTX-0005

Follow-up recorded by bitty CTX-0426 (official plugin onboarding policy): no current gate proves that a plugins/<name> submodule pin is a commit reachable from the plugin repository mainline (default branch), even though the policy requires it. scripts/validate-registry.ts checks entry schema, duplicate ids, repository URL existence, license, and compatibility syntax only; registry-check only detects a stale generated/registry.json.

Scope: add a bounded reachability check (for example git ls-remote plus an ancestry check, or the GitHub compare API) that fails when an official plugin submodule pin is not an ancestor of the plugin default branch; degrade gracefully offline with a notice, consistent with the existing network guard.

Acceptance: runs through the justfile only, covered by tests/registry.test.ts including an offline path; existing palette/statusline/activity pins pass; policy and README maintainer steps updated if the gate changes them.
title: chore(registry): validate official plugin submodule pins are mainline commits

description:
Priority: P2 | Area: plugins | Labels: chore,area:plugins,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: OQ-053 | Task: CTX-0006

Follow-up recorded by bitty CTX-0426 (official plugin onboarding policy): checkLocalManifests in scripts/validate-registry.ts silently skips an official entry when plugins/<name>/bitty-plugin.toml is missing, and nothing checks that the .gitmodules URL for plugins/<name> matches the entry repository field. An official entry can therefore exist with no pinned submodule, or with a mismatched URL.

Scope: static offline checks that (1) every registry/official/<name>.toml has a plugins/<name> submodule declared in .gitmodules, (2) the submodule URL matches the entry repository field, and (3) plugins/<name> directories with no official entry are reported; keep diagnostic severities consistent with existing output.

Acceptance: covered by tests/registry.test.ts; the existing three official entries pass; just registry-validate and just check green; policy and README maintainer steps updated if the gate changes them.
title: chore(registry): require a plugins/<name> submodule for every official entry
fix(ci): harden CarryCtx snapshot-source gate and closeout publication

description:
Priority: P1 | Area: registry | Labels: feat,area:registry | Milestone: v0.1.0

Wave B Phase 1 (minimal usable), user-confirmed depth: populate manifest_hash for the 5 official entries + surface signature_status; NO key material, NO verification logic, NO signature values.

Outcome: all 5 official registry entries (activity, file-manager, git-panel, palette, statusline) carry manifest_hash = sha256:<hex> computed over the owning repo bitty-plugin.toml at a pinned revision; generated/registry.json carries manifest_hash + signature_status; registry-validate + registry-check pass with no integrity warnings for official entries; store surfaces signature_status (unsigned badge/column or docs note, gap-only).

Acceptance:
- manifest_hash present in all 5 registry/official/*.toml
- just registry-generate output carries manifest_hash + signature_status for all 5
- just registry-validate + just registry-check pass, no integrity warnings for official entries
- signature_status surfaced where a user looks (store UI/docs gap only)
- refresh procedure documented + CHANGELOG entry

Trust boundaries: owning repos under workspace root are READ-ONLY evidence (activity especially: bitty-ai-adjacent, registry metadata only). No keys, signatures, verification, no community/ changes, no owning-repo modifications.

Scopes: registry/official/*.toml, scripts/generate-index.ts (if needed), app/src/registry.ts + store UI gap, registry docs/justfile help, CHANGELOG, generated/registry.json (via generate).
